items.question: What epithet and structural form characterize the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is named in sequence.
This cakra is described with the epithet royal.
This cakra has eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is the royal eight-petaled wheel with a pericarp.
uncertainties: Whether rājānam functions as a proper name or a descriptive epithet is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
